observation.initial_state: A large, dense cluster of colorful fireworks (red, green, purple, orange) is already fully expanded and illuminating the night sky. Smoke from previous explosions lingers near the horizon line at the bottom of the frame.
visible_changes: Throughout the sequence, the main outer shells of the fireworks remain relatively static in position but slowly fade in brightness.
New bursts appear within the existing cloud: initially small white/gold sparks emerge around 0.5s-1.0s, followed by distinct red spherical bursts expanding on the left side around 1.5s-2.0s.
The central area transitions from a mix of colors to being dominated by bright red bursts that expand outward.
Smoke clouds drift slightly and become more illuminated by the changing colors of the explosions below them.
The overall shape of the firework display remains consistent, with new elements filling in gaps rather than replacing the whole structure.
uncertain_details: The exact timing of when individual shells were launched is not visible, only their detonation and expansion.
Whether the camera is completely stationary or has very slight handheld shake is difficult to determine definitively due to the scale of the scene.
